name: Zstandard (zstd)
summary: Modern ultra-fast, high-density lossless compression created by Facebook/Meta.
analogy: A high-speed industrial baler that packs boxes tighter while running three times faster than older machines.
what_you_gain: Significantly higher compression ratios and blazingly fast multi-gigabyte decompression throughput.
what_you_lose: Compatibility: Built-in Windows Explorer and older macOS Archive Utilities cannot open zstd zips natively.
best_for: Internal backups, developer tools, database dumps, and systems with Boa or 7-Zip installed.
avoid_for: Sharing with non-technical users who rely exclusively on default OS double-click extraction.
go_deeper: Standardized in RFC 8878 and PKZIP method 93. Utilizes Finite State Entropy (FSE / tANS) coding with large window search.
